question: What has the chicken/Henrietta investigation been missing when read backwards from current CS2 code to earlier map and cosmetic clues?

evidence: GameTracking-CS2 csgo.fgd defines cs_pet_placement using models/pets/egg_pristine.vmdl and describes it as a location on the map where to place pet.
Current client/server schema dumps contain C_CSPetPlacement and CCSPetPlacement classes.
Current xpshop.js calls InventoryAPI.GetPetItemID() and contains the localization key #chicken_egg_cannot_bid_own in a pet-ownership bidding gate.
Current model game data defines chicken_metadata with weighted material groups and material parameters using Seed Generation Value.
Current animation preview data defines WorldModel_EGG and ViewModel_EGG for models/pets/egg_pristine.vmdl, including right-hand attachment for the viewmodel.
Dataminer reports exposed egg_pristine, chicken-in-hands animations and pet-related work before the present code path became this explicit.
Train returned with the missing-chicken poster naming Henrietta.
Contemporary dataminer interpretation treated the Henrietta poster as a pet-system teaser.
The Armory introduced weapon charms before the Henrietta poster appeared.
Charm | Chicken Lil' already existed in the Missing Link Charm Collection before Train's Henrietta poster.
Chicken animation work and reported first-person-compatible inspect animations predated the Train poster.
CS2 beta datamining already contained an unknown cosmetic category called Pets, with speculation around chickens/companions.

corrections.reason: Chicken Lil' predates the Henrietta poster and is a stylized weapon charm rather than the crested collared chicken shown on the poster.

corrections.previous_candidate: Henrietta is a literal hidden physical chicken somewhere on de_train
corrections.reason: Targeted noclip sweep found no physical Henrietta; ent_find henrietta/pigeon/pet returned zero; generic DM chickens were shown to be runtime population entities; no Henrietta-specific asset-name hit was found.

missing_abstraction.finding: The investigation was treating MISSING CHICKEN primarily as a map-location riddle. Reverse chronology instead points to a long-running unreleased/integrating PET CHICKEN SYSTEM.
missing_abstraction.strongest_model: Henrietta is likely a diegetic narrative breadcrumb/mascot for the chicken-pet category, not necessarily an object placed on Train and not the already-released Chicken Lil' charm.
